mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original observer and fixed celestial coordinate anchors. Require a visible gaze, hand or body action before each exact semantic word appears. Build each word from a measurable orbital, waveform, axis or gravity behavior inside the same space. Escalate from body-scale diagrams to cosmic scale while preserving observer identity and coordinate continuity. Collapse the celestial system back to the same observer and one readable terminal word. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original observer and fixed celestial coordinate anchors.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Require a visible gaze, hand or body action before each exact semantic word appears.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Build each word from a measurable orbital, waveform, axis or gravity behavior inside the same space.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Escalate from body-scale diagrams to cosmic scale while preserving observer identity and coordinate continuity.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Collapse the celestial system back to the same observer and one readable terminal word.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.
